```artifact
TC-001: Verify system availability during defined outage window (VIRTUA-13-10)
  - On the second Sunday of the month, during the defined 10-minute outage window, verify system is unavailable
  - Verify outage duration is exactly 10 minutes

TC-002: Verify system availability on non-second Sunday (VIRTUA-13-10)
  - On a non-second Sunday (e.g., first Sunday), verify system is available

TC-003: Verify full backup every night (VIRTUA-13-11)
  - Check backup log for consecutive nights to confirm full backup occurrence

TC-004: Verify backup cycle of 30 days (VIRTUA-13-11)
  - After 31 days of backups, verify oldest backup (day 0) is deleted and 30 backups remain

TC-005: Verify rollback by a month (VIRTUA-13-12)
  - Initiate rollback to exactly one month prior to current date and verify successful restoration

TC-006: Verify backup restoration and purge (VIRTUA-13-13, VIRTUA-13-14)
  - After backup, restore on dummy production system and verify completeness
  - Verify dummy production database is purged post-restoration

TC-007: Verify backup storage location (VIRTUA-13-15)
  - Check backup configuration to confirm storage location is "Mangalore HQ"

TC-008: Verify compliance report generation (VIRTUA-13-16)
  - Generate compliance report and verify it runs without error
```
